import MumfordLib.SourceComplexExteriorCohomology
import MumfordLib.SourceComplexFirstCohomology
import MumfordLib.ExteriorCohomologyAlternating
import MumfordLib.SingularCohomologyExteriorExt

/-!
# Integral cohomology as forms on the intrinsic period lattice

The source exterior cup comparison and degree-one period duality identify
integral singular cohomology with alternating forms in every degree. The
period identification used here is normalized by the geometric exponential
loops. Iterated cup products evaluate as determinants of singular cohomology
evaluations on those loops.

Reference: Mumford, *Abelian Varieties*, Chapter I, Section 1, p. 3.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open scoped Topology Manifold ContDiff IsMulCommutative

namespace Mumford.Analytic

variable {E H : Type*} {G : Type}
  [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E]
  [TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners ℂ E H)
  [TopologicalSpace G] [ChartedSpace H G] [Group G]
  [LieGroup I ω G] [T2Space G] [I.Boundaryless]
  [CompactSpace G] [PreconnectedSpace G]

/-- The intrinsic period lattice is a finite free integral module, with both
properties transported from the discrete full lattice in the manifold model. -/
theorem compactComplexLieGroupPeriodLattice_free_finite :
    letI : FiniteDimensional ℂ E :=
      FiniteDimensional.of_locallyCompact_manifold G I
    letI : CompleteSpace E := FiniteDimensional.complete ℂ E
    letI : IsMulCommutative G := complexLieGroup_isMulCommutative (G := G) I
    letI : CommGroup G := inferInstance
    Module.Free ℤ (intrinsicComplexExponentialPeriodLattice (G := G) I) ∧
      Module.Finite ℤ (intrinsicComplexExponentialPeriodLattice (G := G) I) := by
  letI : FiniteDimensional ℂ E :=
    FiniteDimensional.of_locallyCompact_manifold G I
  letI : CompleteSpace E := FiniteDimensional.complete ℂ E
  letI : IsMulCommutative G := complexLieGroup_isMulCommutative (G := G) I
  letI : CommGroup G := inferInstance
  rw [intrinsicComplexExponentialPeriodLattice_comap (G := G) I]
  letI : DiscreteTopology (canonicalComplexExponentialPeriodLattice (G := G) I) :=
    canonicalComplexExponentialPeriodLattice_discreteTopology (G := G) I
  letI : IsZLattice ℝ (canonicalComplexExponentialPeriodLattice (G := G) I) :=
    canonicalComplexExponentialPeriodLattice_isZLattice (G := G) I
  let e := ((complexLieAlgebraEquiv (G := G) I).symm.restrictScalars ℤ).ofSubmodule'
    (canonicalComplexExponentialPeriodLattice (G := G) I)
  exact ⟨Module.Free.of_equiv e.symm, Module.Finite.equiv e.symm⟩

/-- Integral cohomology is the module of alternating forms on the intrinsic
exponential period lattice, using the chosen degree-one period comparison. -/
def compactComplexLieGroupCohomologyAlternatingEquiv (n : ℕ) :
    letI : FiniteDimensional ℂ E :=
      FiniteDimensional.of_locallyCompact_manifold G I
    letI : CompleteSpace E := FiniteDimensional.complete ℂ E
    letI : IsMulCommutative G := complexLieGroup_isMulCommutative (G := G) I
    letI : CommGroup G := inferInstance
    IntegralSingularCohomology (TopCat.of G) n ≃ₗ[ℤ]
      AlternatingMap ℤ (intrinsicComplexExponentialPeriodLattice (G := G) I) ℤ (Fin n) := by
  letI : FiniteDimensional ℂ E :=
    FiniteDimensional.of_locallyCompact_manifold G I
  letI : CompleteSpace E := FiniteDimensional.complete ℂ E
  letI : IsMulCommutative G := complexLieGroup_isMulCommutative (G := G) I
  letI : CommGroup G := inferInstance
  letI := (compactComplexLieGroupPeriodLattice_free_finite (G := G) I).1
  letI := (compactComplexLieGroupPeriodLattice_free_finite (G := G) I).2
  exact exteriorCohomologyAlternatingEquiv
    (compactComplexLieGroupFirstCohomologyPeriodDualEquiv (G := G) I) n
    (compactComplexLieGroupExteriorPowerEquiv (G := G) I n)

@[simp]
theorem compactComplexLieGroupCohomologyAlternatingEquiv_apply
    (n : ℕ) (c : IntegralSingularCohomology (TopCat.of G) n)
    : letI : FiniteDimensional ℂ E :=
        FiniteDimensional.of_locallyCompact_manifold G I
      letI : CompleteSpace E := FiniteDimensional.complete ℂ E
      letI : IsMulCommutative G := complexLieGroup_isMulCommutative (G := G) I
      letI : CommGroup G := inferInstance
      ∀ v : Fin n → intrinsicComplexExponentialPeriodLattice (G := G) I,
        compactComplexLieGroupCohomologyAlternatingEquiv (G := G) I n c v =
          exteriorPower.pairingDual ℤ
            (intrinsicComplexExponentialPeriodLattice (G := G) I) n
            (exteriorPower.map n
              (compactComplexLieGroupFirstCohomologyPeriodDualEquiv (G := G) I).toLinearMap
              ((compactComplexLieGroupExteriorPowerEquiv (G := G) I n).symm c))
            (exteriorPower.ιMulti ℤ n v) := by
  letI : FiniteDimensional ℂ E :=
    FiniteDimensional.of_locallyCompact_manifold G I
  letI : CompleteSpace E := FiniteDimensional.complete ℂ E
  letI : IsMulCommutative G := complexLieGroup_isMulCommutative (G := G) I
  letI : CommGroup G := inferInstance
  letI := (compactComplexLieGroupPeriodLattice_free_finite (G := G) I).1
  letI := (compactComplexLieGroupPeriodLattice_free_finite (G := G) I).2
  intro v
  exact exteriorCohomologyAlternatingEquiv_apply
    (compactComplexLieGroupFirstCohomologyPeriodDualEquiv (G := G) I) n
    (compactComplexLieGroupExteriorPowerEquiv (G := G) I n) c v

theorem compactComplexLieGroupCohomologyAlternatingEquiv_bijective (n : ℕ) :
    Function.Bijective (compactComplexLieGroupCohomologyAlternatingEquiv (G := G) I n) := by
  letI : FiniteDimensional ℂ E :=
    FiniteDimensional.of_locallyCompact_manifold G I
  letI : CompleteSpace E := FiniteDimensional.complete ℂ E
  letI : IsMulCommutative G := complexLieGroup_isMulCommutative (G := G) I
  letI : CommGroup G := inferInstance
  letI := (compactComplexLieGroupPeriodLattice_free_finite (G := G) I).1
  letI := (compactComplexLieGroupPeriodLattice_free_finite (G := G) I).2
  exact (compactComplexLieGroupCohomologyAlternatingEquiv (G := G) I n).bijective

/-- An iterated cup evaluates on periods as the determinant of the degree-one
period evaluations. This includes the empty cup in degree zero. -/
theorem compactComplexLieGroupCohomologyAlternatingEquiv_iteratedCup
    (n : ℕ) (c : Fin n → IntegralSingularCohomology (TopCat.of G) 1) :
    letI : FiniteDimensional ℂ E :=
      FiniteDimensional.of_locallyCompact_manifold G I
    letI : CompleteSpace E := FiniteDimensional.complete ℂ E
    letI : IsMulCommutative G := complexLieGroup_isMulCommutative (G := G) I
    letI : CommGroup G := inferInstance
    ∀ v : Fin n → intrinsicComplexExponentialPeriodLattice (G := G) I,
      compactComplexLieGroupCohomologyAlternatingEquiv (G := G) I n
          (singularCohomologyIteratedCup (TopCat.of G) n c) v =
        Matrix.det (Matrix.of (fun i j =>
          compactComplexLieGroupFirstCohomologyPeriodDualEquiv (G := G) I (c j) (v i))) := by
  letI : FiniteDimensional ℂ E :=
    FiniteDimensional.of_locallyCompact_manifold G I
  letI : CompleteSpace E := FiniteDimensional.complete ℂ E
  letI : IsMulCommutative G := complexLieGroup_isMulCommutative (G := G) I
  letI : CommGroup G := inferInstance
  letI := (compactComplexLieGroupPeriodLattice_free_finite (G := G) I).1
  letI := (compactComplexLieGroupPeriodLattice_free_finite (G := G) I).2
  intro v
  rw [← singularCohomologyExteriorPower_ιMulti (X := TopCat.of G) n c]
  rw [← compactComplexLieGroupExteriorPowerEquiv_apply (G := G) I n
    (exteriorPower.ιMulti ℤ n c)]
  exact exteriorCohomologyAlternatingEquiv_apply_cup_ιMulti
    (compactComplexLieGroupFirstCohomologyPeriodDualEquiv (G := G) I) n
    (compactComplexLieGroupExteriorPowerEquiv (G := G) I n) c v

/-- On periods corresponding to fundamental-group elements under the chosen
comparison, the determinant entries are the singular cohomology characters. -/
theorem compactComplexLieGroupCohomologyAlternatingEquiv_iteratedCup_period
    (n : ℕ) (c : Fin n → IntegralSingularCohomology (TopCat.of G) 1)
    (γ : Fin n → Additive (FundamentalGroup G 1)) :
    compactComplexLieGroupCohomologyAlternatingEquiv (G := G) I n
        (singularCohomologyIteratedCup (TopCat.of G) n c)
        (fun i => compactComplexLieGroupFundamentalGroupPeriodAddEquiv (G := G) I (γ i)) =
      Matrix.det (Matrix.of (fun i j =>
        singularFirstCohomologyCharacter (X := TopCat.of G) 1 (c j) (γ i))) := by
  rw [compactComplexLieGroupCohomologyAlternatingEquiv_iteratedCup]
  simp only [compactComplexLieGroupFirstCohomologyPeriodDualEquiv_apply_period]

/-- The canonical comparison sends a cup of degree-one classes to the
determinant of their evaluations on the actual exponential period loops. -/
theorem compactComplexLieGroupCohomologyAlternatingEquiv_iteratedCup_exponentialLoop
    (n : ℕ) (c : Fin n → IntegralSingularCohomology (TopCat.of G) 1) :
    letI : FiniteDimensional ℂ E :=
      FiniteDimensional.of_locallyCompact_manifold G I
    letI : CompleteSpace E := FiniteDimensional.complete ℂ E
    letI : IsMulCommutative G := complexLieGroup_isMulCommutative (G := G) I
    letI : CommGroup G := inferInstance
    ∀ v : Fin n → intrinsicComplexExponentialPeriodLattice (G := G) I,
      compactComplexLieGroupCohomologyAlternatingEquiv (G := G) I n
          (singularCohomologyIteratedCup (TopCat.of G) n c) v =
        Matrix.det (Matrix.of (fun i j =>
          singularFirstCohomologyLoopEval (X := TopCat.of G) 1 (c j)
            (compactComplexLieGroupExponentialLoop (G := G) I (v i)))) := by
  letI : FiniteDimensional ℂ E :=
    FiniteDimensional.of_locallyCompact_manifold G I
  letI : CompleteSpace E := FiniteDimensional.complete ℂ E
  letI : IsMulCommutative G := complexLieGroup_isMulCommutative (G := G) I
  letI : CommGroup G := inferInstance
  intro v
  rw [compactComplexLieGroupCohomologyAlternatingEquiv_iteratedCup]
  congr 1
  funext i j
  exact compactComplexLieGroupFirstCohomologyPeriodDualEquiv_apply_exponentialLoop
    (G := G) I (c j) (v i) (compactComplexLieGroupExponentialLoop (G := G) I (v i))
    (compactComplexLieGroupExponentialLoop_apply (G := G) I (v i))

/-- Integral cohomology is canonically the space of alternating forms on the
intrinsic period lattice. The isomorphism is uniquely determined by cup products
and evaluation on geometric exponential loops, in every degree including zero. -/
theorem compactComplexLieGroup_integralCohomology (n : ℕ) :
    letI : FiniteDimensional ℂ E :=
      FiniteDimensional.of_locallyCompact_manifold G I
    letI : CompleteSpace E := FiniteDimensional.complete ℂ E
    letI : IsMulCommutative G := complexLieGroup_isMulCommutative (G := G) I
    letI : CommGroup G := inferInstance
    ∃! e : IntegralSingularCohomology (TopCat.of G) n ≃ₗ[ℤ]
        AlternatingMap ℤ (intrinsicComplexExponentialPeriodLattice (G := G) I) ℤ (Fin n),
      ∀ (c : Fin n → IntegralSingularCohomology (TopCat.of G) 1)
        (v : Fin n → intrinsicComplexExponentialPeriodLattice (G := G) I),
        e (singularCohomologyIteratedCup (TopCat.of G) n c) v =
          Matrix.det (Matrix.of (fun i j =>
            singularFirstCohomologyLoopEval (X := TopCat.of G) 1 (c j)
              (compactComplexLieGroupExponentialLoop (G := G) I (v i)))) := by
  letI : FiniteDimensional ℂ E :=
    FiniteDimensional.of_locallyCompact_manifold G I
  letI : CompleteSpace E := FiniteDimensional.complete ℂ E
  letI : IsMulCommutative G := complexLieGroup_isMulCommutative (G := G) I
  letI : CommGroup G := inferInstance
  refine ⟨compactComplexLieGroupCohomologyAlternatingEquiv (G := G) I n,
    compactComplexLieGroupCohomologyAlternatingEquiv_iteratedCup_exponentialLoop
      (G := G) I n, ?_⟩
  intro e he
  apply LinearEquiv.toLinearMap_injective
  apply singularCohomologyLinearMap_ext_of_exteriorPower_surjective (TopCat.of G) n
    (compactComplexLieGroupExteriorPower_bijective (G := G) I n).surjective
  intro c
  ext v
  exact (he c v).trans
    (compactComplexLieGroupCohomologyAlternatingEquiv_iteratedCup_exponentialLoop
      (G := G) I n c v).symm

end Mumford.Analytic
